test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II (Statistics) Official Paper-II (Held On: 19 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: What is the primary challenge in using the free-hand curve method for trend estimation?

options.text: It is time-consuming and computationally intensive
It is subjective and may lead to inconsistent results.

solution:
**The Correct Answer is**__** : **__It is subjective and may lead to inconsistent results.

__**Explanation:**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****It is subjective and may lead to inconsistent results**. Because the free-hand curve method depends on the analyst’s personal judgment while drawing the trend line. Different people may draw different curves for the same data, leading to subjective and inconsistent outcomes.So, it is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• It is time-consuming and computationally intensive
 
 
• The free-hand curve method does not involve calculations or complex procedures.
 
• It is actually quick and simple, not computationally intensive. 
 
 
 
• It cannot identify cyclical patterns
 
 
• ​Although it is crude, the free-hand curve can still **visually show cycles **and general movements in the data. It is not completely incapable of doing so.
